name: signal-reach-reel
description: Signal Reach Instagram Reel — Remotion edit with captions, motion graphics and sound design.

scripts.qa:layout: rm -rf out/layout-qa && remotion render LayoutQA out/layout-qa --sequence --image-format=png --scale=0.25 --muted && python3 scripts/check_layout_qa.py out/layout-qa
scripts.stems: for s in voice music sfx; do remotion render SignalReachReel out/stem-$s.wav --codec=wav --props="{\"stem\":\"$s\"}"; done
